business_problem: TiMi Studio Group needed Delta Force players to coordinate through fast, stable cross-device voice communications because latency, noisy environments, and inconsistent audio quality could directly undermine tactical execution and player immersion.
solution_summary: TiMi Studio Group integrated Tencent Games GVoice into Delta Force to make real-time team communication dependable enough for high-intensity cross-platform play. Player voice traffic from varied devices and network conditions enters GVoice, which provides low-latency transport alongside AI noise suppression and directional voice capture so squad communication stays intelligible in noisy combat scenarios. The same voice stack also exposes precise ASR capabilities for reliable voice input processing, helping the game support responsive speech interactions without distracting players from match flow. By combining stable voice channels, speech-recognition support, and broad device compatibility in one service, the architecture keeps coordination inside the live gameplay loop instead of forcing players to rely on external tools. The result is a communication layer tuned for fast tactical execution, immersive social play, and consistent quality across PC, mobile, and other platforms.

solution_components.name: Tencent Games GVoice
solution_components.role: Delivers the low-latency, stable real-time voice channels used for squad coordination during gameplay.

solution_components.name: ASR
solution_components.role: Provides speech recognition for reliable voice input processing inside the game.

data_flow: Players speak from different devices and network conditions into Tencent Games GVoice, where AI noise suppression and directional capture improve the audio stream, ASR processes speech input, and low-latency voice channels deliver coordinated communication back to squad members during live matches.
business_outcome: Delta Force delivered more responsive and reliable team communication, including sub-300 ms end-to-end latency, which improved teamwork, immersion, and the dependability of voice-based coordination during intense combat.
metrics: Consistent sub 300 ms end to end latency ensures real time responsiveness.
